{
  "name": "proposal-kit",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary, built so an AI coding tool can't make the costly mistakes quietly. Made-up data.",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "tokens": "node scripts/check-tokens.mjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "check": "npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run tokens && npm run test",
    "storybook": "storybook dev -p 6006",
    "build-storybook": "storybook build -o storybook-static"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "1.2.0",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "1.5.0",
    "class-variance-authority": "0.7.1",
    "clsx": "2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "1.63.0",
    "react": "19.3.1",
    "react-dom": "19.3.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "3.7.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "10.0.1",
    "@storybook/addon-a11y": "10.6.5",
    "@storybook/addon-docs": "10.6.5",
    "@storybook/react-vite": "10.6.5",

    "@testing-library/dom": "10.4.2",
    "@testing-library/jest-dom": "7.0.1",

    "axe-core": "4.14.0",
    "eslint": "10.13.0",
    "globals": "17.13.0",
    "jsdom": "30.1.3",
    "storybook": "10.6.5",
    "tailwindcss": "4.3.3",
    "typescript": "6.0.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.72.1",
    "vite": "8.3.5",
    "vitest": "4.1.12",
    "vitest-axe": "0.1.0"
  }
}

content.text:
I wrote the summary page to `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`. It exports `GeneratedSummary()` with no props, and all the proposal data is kept in that file. I couldn't run commands, so it hasn't been type-checked, linted, tested or viewed in a browser. Run `npm run check` before relying on it.

**The numbers all agree with each other.** I checked every figure against the others before writing the page:
- 18 × 410 W = 7.38 kW.
- $13,950 + $6,450 + $1,600 = $22,000, and $22,000 − $2,000 down = $20,000 financed.
- A $20,000 loan at 6.49% APR over 240 months comes to $149.00 a month, and 240 × $149 = $35,760.
- 11,900 kWh × $0.15 = $1,785 in the first year. With the rate rising 3% a year, that adds up to about $65,080 over 25 years.

**How the page uses the repo's components:**
- **Money:** every dollar amount is passed in cents and shown through `Money`.
- **Monthly payment:** `PaymentLine` shows $149.00 per month with "6.49% APR · 240 months (20 years)" on the same line. A note above it says this is after the $2,000 down payment.
- **Savings:** `SavingsEstimate` works out the savings itself from the inputs (11,900 kWh, $0.15 per kWh, 3% a year, 25 years). It prints about $65,080 total and $1,785 for the first year, with the "Estimated" badge, the assumptions and "Not a guarantee."
- **Other sections:** a header with the installer, P-2077, the prepared date, a "Ready to sign" badge (icon plus text), Maria's name and address. Then cards for the system, the price breakdown and the financing (total, down payment, amount financed and total of 240 payments).
- **Styling:** only the theme's color and spacing classes are used, with no hex colors or pixel values.

**Things to check:**
- **Sign button:** the "Review and sign" button doesn't do anything yet. Connect it to your signing flow.
- **Lender:** no lender name is shown, because none was given. If there is one, pass it to `PaymentLine` with its `lender` prop.
- **Note I added:** the financing card says that the $35,760 total of payments doesn't include the $2,000 down payment.
- **Icon name:** for the badge icon I used `CircleCheck` from lucide-react. If the type check says that name doesn't exist in lucide-react 1.63.0, rename it.
